scope: train64 inner fold0 only; original dev16 labels not read; diagnostic post-hoc evidence, not model fitting or new predictions

oracle_diagnostics_not_predictions.warning: Post-hoc gold-derived ceiling calculations only. No oracle predictions are saved or eligible for selection/submission.

recommendations.name: Context-aware overlapping candidate competition
recommendations.logic: Keep candidate groups by intersecting span; compute lexical score, Sap score and margin, ontology specificity, boundary/content modifiers, patient-clinical assertion, negation, and whether a shorter exact span loses a semantic modifier. Learn ranking on training-fold OOF only. Emit one coherent span/concept (or justified compound), not every ancestor.
recommendations.reason: Eight of nine high-scoring missing concepts overlap selected alternative concepts; uniform threshold lowering does not solve competition.
recommendations.ablation: Hold candidate pool fixed and swap only selection ranker; inspect menF1/docF1 and relation precision on fold0 then all frozen folds.

recommendations.name: Typed local assertion state
recommendations.logic: Expose polarity, hypothetical/test-target/general assertion and developmental inability as features, not blanket section exclusions. Extend scoped not-have/show/present/observe patterns and pseudo-negation. Build from training evidence, preserve original offsets.
recommendations.reason: Current final concept coverage recall is 98.1%, while 109 relation FPs remain. Assertion quality can improve precision without indiscriminate all-patient expansion.
recommendations.ablation: Compare individual features, including patient-token distance. Count clinically valid but gold-absent cases separately to avoid overgeneralizing annotation quirks.

recommendations.name: Bounded patient and cohort scope
recommendations.logic: Maintain topic patient, sentence experiencer and explicit cohort separately. Both/all/each expands only a resolved set of target IDs; scope ends at contrast, one/the other, next explicit subject or case header. Unlisted patient/pedigree anchors break inheritance. Resolve former/latter only between two unique antecedents; abstain when unknown.
recommendations.reason: All five final-covered FNs mostly need local lexical normalization or narrow coreference; global all-patient fallback risks the 17 wrong-patient FPs.
recommendations.ablation: Shared cohort, unlisted-anchor barrier and latter resolution separately, before combined model; report FP/TP changes and unresolved-subject rate.

recommendations.name: Coordination-normalized candidate views
recommendations.logic: Generate virtual matching views for A and B were MODIFIER and MODIFIER A and B, and measurement/anatomy heads; map proposed concepts back to original continuous evidence spans, preserving start/end. Propagate modifiers only when grammar supports both conjuncts. Use full phrase reranking to avoid treating ordinary anatomy or analyte names as abnormalities.
recommendations.reason: Predicative poor eye contact, limbs weakness, specific cough, and directional biochemical abnormalities are not fixed by nearest-patient logic.
recommendations.ablation: Candidate recall and precision measured separately; synthetic alias templates derived from HPO and train-fold evidence only, never this validation document identity.

limitations: Only train64 inner fold0 was examined; no original dev16 gold was read. These are explanatory post-hoc diagnostics, not an independent evaluation of any new method.
Final document-level concept coverage is an optimistic bound: a concept occurring for another patient or in generic discussion is not evidence for the target patient.
Candidate pool is the frozen scored pool supplied for this snapshot, not an exhaustive set of all possible HPO phrases.
Error examples are evidence only and must not become document/patient/concept-specific runtime rules.
Context lists in raw error records are truncated to six occurrences or best three candidates; curated findings inspect relevant full passages.
Gold-relative FP categories do not establish clinical falsehood; several clear annotation granularity/incompleteness examples exist.
No repository files, model parameters, output predictions or official submissions were modified.
